criterion_text: On integrated staging, a source-aligned mixed-load protocol/runtime Case proves simultaneous control completion, independent requests and terminal streaming under bounded saturation; no silent loss, stale-generation mutation, ordering violation or unbounded task growth; disconnect settles connection-owned work.

verifiers.summary: Mixed control/request/stream load is bounded and explicit: independent queries overlap, saturated admission is refused rather than silently dropped, ordered registration fences dependent state, per-resource worker counts stay bounded, terminal frames are applied in order, and a client that stops draining is closed by the stream bound

evidence.value: b2fe36db2adfdd490a380398f1fa5580cd5fa99a: control/registration ordering, independent queries, explicit overload refusal, bounded per-connection/key workers, ordered terminal frames and the stream stall verdict all held in the same integrated runtime
